Metadata.title: Ram Farid — Full-stack JavaScript Engineer
Metadata.description: Ram Farid is a full-stack JavaScript engineer in Cairo, building fast, clear web apps with Next.js, React and Node.js.

intro.title: I build fast, clear <hl>web apps</hl>.
intro.lead: I’m Ram Farid, a full-stack JavaScript engineer in Cairo. I work with Next.js, React and Node.js, from the screens people use to the server and database behind them.

about.title: One engineer, front to back
about.body1: Since {since} I’ve built web apps for {clients, number} clients, and I own each one end to end: the interface, the API and the database, through to launch.
about.body2: I work in English and Arabic, so right-to-left layouts are part of the build from day one, not a fix after launch.

services.title: What I can build for you

apps.title: New web apps
apps.body: A product your customers sign in to and use, built with Next.js and Node.js from the first screen to the database.

rebuilds.title: Rebuilds of dated sites
rebuilds.body: Your current site moved to a modern, fast stack, keeping your content and your URLs.

localization.title: Multilingual, localized products
localization.body: Sites and apps built for every language they serve: translated content, right-to-left layouts and local date and number formats, from the first release.

servers.title: Performant server management
servers.body: Servers that stay fast and up under real traffic: deployment, monitoring, caching and tuning, handled end to end.
